title: Check a project request
responsibility: Checks the selected project, branch, commit and chosen model before a conversation starts work.

inputs.name: prepareProjectTask.preparation
inputs.description: Provides the active project session and provider selector used for project validation, change-environment preparation, and runner selection. The session and provider implementations are supplied by the caller.

inputs.name: prepareProjectTask.request
inputs.description: Identifies the project, branch, and commit to validate, and supplies the provider, model, and effort passed to runner selection. The returned context retains this request, and a branch or commit mismatch rejects preparation.

inputs.name: prepareProjectTask.controller
inputs.description: Supplies the signal checked after runner selection and before the context is returned. If it is aborted at that check, preparation throws RunCancelled.

outputs.name: prepareProjectTask
outputs.description: Resolves to a ProjectTaskContext containing the preparation, validated project, root, revision, planning data, original request, selected runner, generated UUID, and abort signal. It is returned only when the refreshed branch and commit match the request and the controller is not aborted at the final check.

errors.name: ProjectRevisionChangedError
errors.description: Thrown with the message “The project revision changed. Refresh before asking the agent.” when the refreshed project's branch or commit differs from the request.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Thrown when controller.signal.aborted is true after provider selection and before the context is returned. The earlier project checks and runner selection occur before this abort check.
